articles.title: Trump Wades Into Ireland's Toughest Question: 'It's Going to Happen Eventually'
articles.summary: During a Dublin visit, President Trump said Irish reunification would be 'fantastic' — a topic U.S. presidents usually avoid. Northern Ireland has been part of the U.K. for a century, and the issue once fueled decades of violence.

articles.title: Unbeaten India and Sri Lanka Clash for Women's T20 Asia Cup Glory
articles.summary: India faces Sri Lanka in the Women's T20 Asia Cup final Sunday in Dubai. India has won a record seven titles; Sri Lanka is the defending champion. Both teams are unbeaten, and the star bowlers are tied at 11 wickets each.

articles.title: Reform UK's £72 Million Windfall: Two Crypto Donors, One Record, Many Questions
articles.summary: Reform UK received two £36 million donations in two days — more than all UK parties got last year combined. The donors are crypto investors. The party faces scrutiny over donation rules and police investigations.
